scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @honostar/logging build && pnpm routes:generate && pnpm contracts:generate && concurrently "pnpm assets:dev" "tsx watch src/index.ts"
scripts.start: pnpm --filter @honostar/logging build && pnpm routes:generate && pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm assets:build && tsx src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @honostar/core build && pnpm --filter @honostar/logging build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
